ns2:course.label: Honors Senior Thesis
ns2:course.description: A requirement for all seniors writing honors thesis and who are candidates for departmental distinction in anthropology. No graduate credit. Prerequisite: Senior standing; ANTH 391; 3.6 GPA in anthropology; 37 hours of anthropology courses, and consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: Senior standing; ANTH 391; 3.6 GPA in anthropology; 37 hours of anthropology courses, and consent of instructor.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: May not be taken concurrently with ANTH 390.
